summary: A well-structured, mostly complete mission design for GBR reef monitoring with sound STK evidence and justified launch/orbit choices. To reach the top band, resolve internal contradictions (EOL drag-sail, orbit resolution statement), show your J2 hand calculation, include STK software files, number your figures, and replace Wikipedia/bare URLs with properly formatted, credible references.
next_steps: Fix the contradictory statements in the EOL drag-sail paragraph and the orbit section's 'low resolution images which is also desirable' claim, then re-read each section for internal consistency.
Include your STK scenario/software files (appendix or submission package) and show the J2 hand calculation behind your inclination-altitude plot.
Number all figures (Figure 1, 2, ...) and cross-reference them in text; replace Wikipedia and bare URLs with peer-reviewed or primary sources formatted consistently (e.g. IEEE style).

criteria.C1: Accomplished (8/10). Your Introduction clearly covers the primary mission (GBR coral reef monitoring via fluid lensing), the rationale, the single-spacecraft justification, and users/operator/funding, with literature citations. To reach the very top, expand the user discussion (e.g. how CSIRO/BOM would actually use the data) with more specific detail and referencing.
criteria.C2: Accomplished (7/10). All major requirements are addressed: Vega E from Guiana Space Centre with justification, a 600 km SSO with full orbital elements, no manoeuvres until EOL, ground station coverage and access frequency via STK, and a 5-year mission with drag-sail EOL. To improve: include your STK software files, show the J2 hand calculation behind the inclination-altitude plot, and correct the contradictory 'low resolution images which is also desirable' statement.
criteria.C3: Adequate (6/10). Your Conclusion summarises each segment and honestly flags the Vega E availability risk, but it largely restates the design. The next level requires deeper, evidence-driven insights: quantitative outcomes (e.g. revisit time, coverage statistics, data volume) and what they imply for mission feasibility.
criteria.C4: Adequate (5/10). Your structure is clear (headings, TOC, executive summary) and figures are captioned, but they lack figure numbers, and the bibliography uses bare URLs and Wikipedia (disallowed), inconsistently formatted. The garbled drag-sail paragraph also hurts readability. Fix referencing, number figures, and proofread carefully to reach the Accomplished level.
